$comment: How each component of the Monarch web catalogue is covered on Android (Jetpack Compose, Material 3) and iOS (SwiftUI). This is the plan, not an inventory: an entry does not mean the component exists. Only wave 0 is being implemented. The shipped inventory is platforms/android/components.json and platforms/ios/components.json. Explained in docs/architecture/NATIVE-PARITY.md.

coverage.build: Monarch builds a component for this platform: custom, or a wrapper with its own API. name is the Monarch component.
coverage.style: Monarch ships a style or theme layer on the platform control (a ButtonStyle, a ToggleStyle, a Material component themed through MonarchTheme), not a new component.
coverage.native: The platform's own component or API is the answer and Monarch documents it. uses names the exact API.
coverage.compose: No single component: a documented composition of other Monarch native components, listed in dependsOn.
coverage.web-only: Has no meaning in a native app. note gives the reason.
